g1|variants|delivery, picking, packing a.family_title: Outbound Delivery, Picking, Packing, and Goods Issue Family
g1|variants|delivery, picking, packing a.summary: This family covers the core SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash fulfillment execution variants from outbound delivery creation through picking, packing, and final goods issue. Variants differ by automation level, warehouse management integration depth, handling unit usage, and shipping execution path.

variants.name: Standard Delivery with WM/EWM Picking and Manual Goods Issue
variants.when_used: Standard sales order fulfillment utilizing advanced warehouse management for picking and packing with manual post goods issue.
variants.key_config: Delivery type LF mapped to EWM warehouse number, automatic WM transfer order / warehouse task creation upon delivery release, and manual GI posting via /SCWM/PRDO or VL02N.

variants.name: Lean WM Delivery with Automatic Goods Issue
variants.when_used: Simplified warehouse execution where stock is managed at storage location level with automatic goods issue upon picking completion.
variants.key_config: Storage location linked to Lean WM, movement type 601 configured for automatic goods receipt/issue posting upon TO confirmation, and background batch job for delivery creation.

variants.name: Delivery-Free / Direct Goods Issue to Billing
variants.when_used: Specialized service or intangible items where physical delivery, picking, and packing are bypassed and billing is triggered directly from the sales order.
variants.key_config: Item category configured with billing relevance 'F' (Order-related billing document - status based on quantity), omitting delivery creation entirely.

variants.name: Batch-Managed Outbound Delivery with Split Verification
variants.when_used: Fulfillment of regulated or perishable goods requiring explicit batch determination and verification during picking.
variants.key_config: Automatic batch determination active in sales order or delivery, mandatory batch split items in delivery item category, and restricted shelf-life expiration check at pick confirmation.

variants.name: Third-Party Order Processing (TPOP) Fulfillment Hand-off
variants.when_used: Vendor ships directly to the customer; outbound delivery and physical picking/packing are executed by the external vendor while OTC records goods receipt/issue acknowledgment.
variants.key_config: Item category TAS, purchase requisition generated automatically from sales order, and goods receipt / invoice receipt from vendor updates OTC billing status.

g1|core|delivery, picking, packing and g.title: Standard Delivery with WM/EWM Picking and Manual Goods Issue
g1|core|delivery, picking, packing and g.story: Just like a worker packs toys into a cardboard box and seals it with tape before handing it to the delivery truck, a warehouse collects items from shelves, packs them into handling units, and ships them out. In SAP S/4HANA, this process starts when a sales order triggers an outbound delivery document, which passes handling instructions to Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) to pick and pack goods before a manual goods issue updates inventory and accounting.
g1|core|delivery, picking, packing and g.why_business_needs_it: This process ensures that physical warehouse activities match financial records and inventory counts before ownership transfers to the customer. Without this integration, stock quantities remain inaccurate, billing cannot occur, and statutory shipping compliance fails.

modules.role: Creates outbound deliveries from sales orders, triggers EWM warehouse requests, tracks delivery status, and processes billing after goods issue.
modules.hands_off_to: EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) via outbound delivery document creation to execute picking and packing.

modules.role: Manages physical warehouse execution, including warehouse task creation, picking, handling unit packing, and confirmation.
modules.hands_off_to: MM (Materials Management) and FI (Financial Accounting) via goods issue posting to update inventory and post cost of goods sold.

config_steps.step: Define Delivery Types
config_steps.where: OVLCC -- SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Deliveries > Define Delivery Types
config_steps.values: Delivery type LF linked to document category J with output procedure V10000.
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N for table T390 to verify delivery type LF parameters exist.
config_steps.why: A sales order requires an outbound delivery type to generate shipping documents and pass requirements to Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).
config_steps.if_missing: Without delivery type LF, creating an outbound delivery via VL01N fails with message VL001.
actions: Enter transaction code /nOVLCC in the command field and press Enter
Select standard delivery type LF and click on Details magnifying glass icon
Verify document category J is assigned for outbound delivery
Ensure output determination procedure V10000 is populated in the Output field
Check that item category determination is active
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to record changes to the customizing transport request

Select item category TAN and double-click on Details
Verify that value-relevant indicator is active

errors.title: Manual Goods Issue Blocked Due to Incomplete Picking Status
errors.message_text: Goods issue cannot be posted; picking status is not complete
errors.plain_meaning: You tried to ship the goods before the warehouse finished picking them from the shelves.
errors.cause: Delivery type LF requires complete picking (overall pick status 'C') before goods issue can be posted, but EWM warehouse tasks are still open or unconfirmed.
errors.config_step: Define Item Category Controls for Delivery
errors.verify: Confirm all warehouse tasks in EWM, return to VL02N, and verify that the overall picking status turns green ('C').
errors.prevent: Ensure warehouse operators confirm all physical picking tasks in EWM prior to attempting goods issue in the Outbound Delivery Monitor.
errors.ref_title: Goods issue cannot be posted picking status not complete

fix_steps.values: Navigate to Outbound -> Doc. -> Outbound Delivery -> Confirm open Warehouse Tasks

errors.title: Goods Issue Posting Fails Due to Closed Posting Period
errors.message_text: Posting only possible in periods &1 / &2 in company code &3
errors.plain_meaning: The finance department has locked the accounting period for the current date, stopping inventory movement.
errors.cause: The posting date on the outbound delivery falls into a fiscal period that has already been closed by Finance via transaction MMPV or OB52.
errors.verify: Re-open delivery in VL02N, update the actual goods issue date if necessary, and re-attempt Post Goods Issue.
errors.prevent: Coordinate month-end closing schedules between OTC and Finance teams to prevent inventory posting blockages.
errors.ref_title: Posting only possible in periods in company code

fix_steps.values: Enter Company Code and new current Period/Year
Adjust interval for account type + and material account types S to allow current posting date

g1|core|delivery, picking, packing and g.title: Lean WM Delivery with Automatic Goods Issue
g1|core|delivery, picking, packing and g.story: Just like packing your lunchbox before running out the door to catch the school bus, the system packs goods into boxes and creates a shipping list before the truck drives away. Technically, this standard SAP Order-to-Cash process creates an outbound delivery type LF, generates a Lean Warehouse Management transfer order for picking, optionally packs items into Handling Units, and executes an automatic goods issue via background job to update inventory and post the cost of goods sold.
g1|core|delivery, picking, packing and g.why_business_needs_it: Automating the delivery, picking, and goods issue steps removes manual bottlenecks, ensuring high-volume shipping operations meet customer delivery dates without warehouse clerks manually posting each truckload. It directly protects company revenue recognition and keeps perpetual inventory balances synchronized with physical stock movements.

modules.role: Creates the outbound delivery document, triggers picking requirements, and handles final billing generation.
modules.hands_off_to: LE-WM to request picking via transfer orders and execute goods issue.

modules.role: Manages warehouse bin locations, creates transfer orders for picking, and confirms stock removal.
modules.hands_off_to: MM-IM to post inventory reduction and general ledger financial impacts upon goods issue.

modules.role: Holds plant stock balances, updates material valuation, and posts the accounting entry for goods issue.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for cost of goods sold and inventory value balancing.

config_steps.step: Maintain Material Master Sales and Warehouse Views
config_steps.where: MM01 -- Logistics > Materials Management > Material Master > Material > Create (General) > Immediately
config_steps.values: Material: FG-01; Item Category Group: NORM; Loading Group: 0001; Whse No: 010; Storage Type: 001
config_steps.check: Display the material using MM03 and verify all sales and warehouse views are correctly maintained.
config_steps.why: Materials require specific sales and warehouse attributes to flow properly through orders, deliveries, and picking tasks.
config_steps.if_missing: Creating sales orders or deliveries for unmaintained materials results in error M3304 (Material not maintained).
actions: Enter /nMM01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Material FG-01 and Industry Sector M, Material Type HAWA
Click Select Views and check Sales: General/Plant, Sales Org. Data 1, and Warehouse Management
Enter Plant 1000 and Storage Location 0001
In Sales views, enter Item Category Group NORM and Loading Group 0001
In Warehouse Management views, enter Warehouse No 010 and Storage Type 001
Save (Ctrl+S) to create the material master record
